canonical_title: Tencent Hy4 preview open-source model release
treatment: Covered as the August 28 open-source preview release. Repeat only for GA/final release, material model-card or license changes, weights/API availability changes, independently reproducible benchmark findings, or major production adoption/breakage.
known_facts: Tencent released and open-sourced Hy4 preview on August 28, 2026.
The model uses a mixture-of-experts design with 770B total parameters and 49B active parameters per text request.
Tencent states the context window exceeds 1M tokens.
It is available through Tencent products including CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy and via API through Tencent Cloud TokenHub and OpenRouter.
Tencent says the preview can over-verify complex answers and sometimes take longer than necessary.
reinclude_only_if: Tencent publishes a final/GA release or materially changes weights, license, model card, context, pricing, or API availability.
A credible independent evaluation produces reproducible results that materially change the performance interpretation.
A major adoption or breakage signal changes practical use of Hy4 preview.
notes: Reuters published at 09:37 UTC (18:37 JST), inside the 2026-08-28 Night Lite window.
